description.value:
When you roll damage for a tech power or class feature and any die shows its maximum possible result, you may roll that die again and keep both results. This can happen only once per casting or use.

Several of your other features send you to the Unstable Engineering Surge table below, rolled with percentile dice:

d100Result
01-02Roll on this table again at the start of each of your turns for the next minute (a repeat of this same result is ignored).
03-04For 1 minute, you see any invisible creature you have line of sight to.
05-06A DRK-1 tracker droid manifests within 5 feet of you, vanishing again after 1 minute.
07-08You involuntarily cast explosion at 3rd level, centered on yourself, without spending tech points.
09-10You involuntarily cast homing rockets at 5th level without spending tech points.
11-12Roll a d10; your height shifts by that many inches — you shrink on an odd result, grow on an even one.
13-14You drop into a standing sleep for 1 minute, or until you take damage.
15-16For 1 minute, you heal 5 hit points at the start of each of your turns.
17-18A long feathered beard sprouts on you, lasting until you sneeze.
19-20You involuntarily cast oil slick centered on yourself without spending tech points.
21-22For 1 minute, the first saving throw any creature makes against you is rolled with disadvantage.
23-24Your skin turns bright blue until something that would end a curse ends it.
25-26An extra eye sprouts, giving you advantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks for 1 minute.
27-28For 1 minute, every tech power of yours that normally takes an action to cast instead takes only a bonus action.
29-30You blink up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space of your choosing that you can see.
31-32You take 2d10 lightning damage and become shocked for 1 minute.
33-34The next damaging tech power you cast within the next minute deals its maximum damage.
35-36Roll a d10; your age shifts by that many years — younger on an odd result, older on an even one.
37-38You bolt out of control for 1 minute, using your full speed to move on every turn.
39-40You heal 2d10 hit points.
41-42Every creature within 30 feet of you is affected by gleaming outline for 1 minute.
43-44For 1 minute, you may blink up to 20 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.
45-46You are blinded and deafened for 1 minute.
47-48For 1 minute, the first ability check, attack roll, or saving throw you make on each of your turns has disadvantage.
49-50You lose the ability to speak for 1 minute; pink bubbles drift from your mouth whenever you try.
51-52A shimmering field grants you +2 AC for 1 minute.
53-54You become immune to alcohol intoxication for the next 5d6 days.
55-56Your hair falls out, regrowing within 24 hours — or, if you had none, you grow a full head of it for 24 hours.
57-58For 1 minute, any unattended flammable object you touch immediately ignites.
59-60You recover tech points equal to your Intelligence modifier (at least 1).
61-62For 1 minute, everything you say comes out as a shout.
63-64You involuntarily cast smoke cloud centered on yourself without spending tech points.
65-66You choose up to three creatures within 30 feet; each takes 4d10 lightning damage.
67-68You become frightened of the nearest creature until the end of your next turn.
69-70Every creature within 30 feet of you turns invisible for 1 minute, ending early if it attacks or casts a power.
71-72You gain resistance to all damage for 1 minute.
73-74A randomly determined creature within 60 feet becomes poisoned for 1d4 hours.
75-76You shed bright light in a 30-foot radius for 1 minute.
77-78Every other creature within 30 feet of you gains the benefit of mirror image for 1 minute.
79-80Illusory butterflies and flower petals drift through the air within 10 feet of you for 1 minute.
81-82You immediately gain one extra action.
83-84Every creature within 30 feet of you takes 1d10 necrotic damage, and you heal an equal amount.
85-86You involuntarily cast mirror image without spending tech points.
87-88You're encased in carbonite and paralyzed for 1 minute, or until you take damage.
89-90You turn invisible and silent for 1 minute, ending early if you attack or cast a power.
91-92If you die within the next minute, you're instantly revived as though by the defibrillate power.
93-94You grow one size category larger for 1 minute.
95-96You and every creature within 30 feet of you become vulnerable to energy damage for 1 minute.
97-98Faint, ethereal music surrounds you for 1 minute.
99-100You recover half of your spent tech points.
